title: Controlled Records Handling Review
summary: Quarterly review of controlled-record routing, reviewer acknowledgements, and terminal-session closeout practices.

sections.title: REVIEW SCOPE
sections.body:
**Review period:** Current quarterly cycle

**Control sample:** Coded routing entries selected from the ordinary records queue

**Review objective:** Confirm that required acknowledgements, classification markings, and closeout entries were present before archival disposition.

sections.title: FINDINGS & DISPOSITION
sections.body:
**Routing review:** Sampled entries followed the assigned review sequence.

**Acknowledgements:** Required role acknowledgements were present in the reviewed set.

**Session closeout:** Terminal closeout entries were complete for the selected records.

**Disposition:** No systemic correction required. One formatting reminder was issued for the next records-control briefing.

sections.title: SUPERVISORY ANNOTATION
sections.summary: The supervisory annotation remains with the originating review file.
